preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abc' for c in input_string)
preconditions.description: The input string consists exclusively of the characters 'a', 'b', and 'c'.

postconditions.expression: all((input_string[i] == 'a' and output_string[i] == 'b') or (input_string[i] == 'b' and output_string[i] == 'a') or (input_string[i] == 'c' and output_string[i] == 'c') for i in range(len(input_string)))
postconditions.description: For every character in the input string, if it is 'a', it is replaced by 'b' in the output, if it is 'b', it is replaced by 'a', and if it is 'c', it remains unchanged.
